nodes.summary: For a nonzero eigenvalue, the eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` are linearly equivalent, via `g` in one direction.
nodes.title: Linear equivalence of eigenspaces of fg and gf

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `eigenspaceCompEquiv`, for endomorphisms of one space.
nodes.title: Eigenspaces of fg and gf are equivalent, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: If `g x = 0` and `x` lies in the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` with `μ ≠ 0`, then `x = 0`. Indeed, on the kernel of `g` the map `f ∘ₗ g` vanishes, so `(f ∘ₗ g - μ • 1) ^ l` acts as `(-μ) ^ l • 1` there.
nodes.title: Kernel of g meets a generalized eigenspace of fg trivially

nodes.summary: For a nonzero scalar, the generalized eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` are finite-dimensional together, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞`.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspaces of fg and gf are finite-dimensional together

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `finite_genEigenspace_comp_iff`.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspaces finite-dimensional together, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: The generalized eigenspaces of rectangular products in opposite orders are finite-dimensional together for a nonzero scalar and every exponent.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspaces of AB and BA are finite-dimensional together

nodes.summary: Generalized eigenspaces of reversed bounded-operator products are finite-dimensional together for a nonzero scalar and every exponent.
nodes.title: Finite-dimensionality of generalized eigenspaces of ST and TS

nodes.summary: The geometric multiplicities of a nonzero eigenvalue of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` agree.
nodes.title: Geometric multiplicities of fg and gf agree

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `finrank_eigenspace_comp_eq`.
nodes.title: Geometric multiplicities of fg and gf agree, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: The geometric multiplicities of a nonzero eigenvalue of `A * B` and of `B * A` agree.
nodes.title: Geometric multiplicities of matrix products AB and BA agree

nodes.summary: The geometric multiplicities of a nonzero eigenvalue of `S * T` and of `T * S` agree, for bounded operators.
nodes.title: Equal geometric multiplicities of nonzero eigenvalues of ST and TS

nodes.summary: The generalized `μ`-eigenspaces of `f ∘ₗ g` and of `g ∘ₗ f` have equal `Module.finrank`, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞` and every nonzero `μ`. They are finite-dimensional together; if both are infinite-dimensional, both finranks are zero. In finite dimension only the stabilized generalized eigenspace (for example at exponent `⊤`) measures algebraic multiplicity.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspaces of fg and gf have equal dimension

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `finrank_genEigenspace_comp_eq`.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspace dimensions agree, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: The generalized `μ`-eigenspaces of `A * B` and of `B * A` have equal `Module.finrank`, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞`.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspaces of AB and BA have equal dimension

nodes.summary: The generalized `μ`-eigenspaces of `S * T` and of `T * S` have equal `Module.finrank`, for every exponent `k : ℕ∞`, for bounded operators.
nodes.title: Equal dimensions of generalized eigenspaces of ST and TS

nodes.summary: The restriction of `g` to the generalized `μ`-eigenspaces.
nodes.title: Restriction of g to generalized eigenspaces of fg and gf

nodes.summary: A nonzero scalar is an eigenvalue of `T† * T` iff it is an eigenvalue of `T * T†`, on a Hilbert space.
nodes.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of an operator times its adjoint, in either order

nodes.summary: A nonzero scalar is an eigenvalue of `f ∘ₗ g` iff it is an eigenvalue of `g ∘ₗ f`.
nodes.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of fg and gf coincide

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `hasEigenvalue_comp_iff`.
nodes.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of fg and gf coincide, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: A nonzero scalar is an eigenvalue of the matrix product `A * B` iff it is an eigenvalue of `B * A`.
nodes.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of matrix products AB and BA coincide

nodes.summary: A nonzero scalar is an eigenvalue of `S * T` iff it is an eigenvalue of `T * S`, for bounded operators.
nodes.title: Nonzero eigenvalues of ST and TS coincide

nodes.summary: An eigenvector of `f ∘ₗ g` for a nonzero eigenvalue is sent by `g` to an eigenvector of `g ∘ₗ f` for the same eigenvalue.
nodes.title: Eigenvectors of fg map to eigenvectors of gf

nodes.summary: The `*` form of `hasEigenvector_comp`.
nodes.title: Eigenvectors of fg map to eigenvectors of gf, for endomorphisms

nodes.summary: The restriction of `g` to a generalized `μ`-eigenspace with `μ ≠ 0` is injective.
nodes.title: Injectivity of g on generalized eigenspaces of fg

nodes.summary: The map `g` restricted to the eigenspaces is injective when `μ ≠ 0`: if `g x = 0` for an eigenvector `x` of `f ∘ₗ g`, then `(f ∘ₗ g) x = 0 = μ • x`, so `x = 0`.
nodes.title: Injectivity of g between eigenspaces of fg and gf

nodes.summary: `g` sends the `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` into the `μ`-eigenspace of `g ∘ₗ f`: if `(f ∘ₗ g) x = μ • x` then `(g ∘ₗ f) (g x) = μ • (g x)`.
nodes.title: Eigenspace of fg maps into the eigenspace of gf

nodes.summary: `g` sends the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `f ∘ₗ g` into the generalized `μ`-eigenspace of `g ∘ₗ f`, for every exponent. This is the intertwining `(g ∘ₗ f) ∘ₗ g = g ∘ₗ (f ∘ₗ g)` applied to Mathlib's `Module.End.mapsTo_genEigenspace_of_comp`.
nodes.title: Generalized eigenspace of fg maps into that of gf

nodes.summary: The map `g` restricted to the eigenspaces is surjective when `μ ≠ 0`: an eigenvector `y` of `g ∘ₗ f` is the image of `μ⁻¹ • f y`.
nodes.title: Surjectivity of g between eigenspaces of fg and gf

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
